<b>Seared Organs</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
15 Seared Organs, 35 [[Shredded Organ]]s, and 10 [[Skewered Organ]]s are required to complete the <i>[[Broodfeast]]</i> Wish, given by [[Huntress]] at [[Putrified Ducts]] (or the <i>[[Runtfeast]]</i> Wish, given by [[Runt]] in the same location after [[Act 3]] begins).

== How to Acquire ==
Only obtainable while <i>Broodfeast</i> or <i>Runtfeast</i> is active. Seared Organs drop from most enemies killed by the following sources:
* [[Needle]] after using [[Flintslate]]
* [[Pimpillo]]
* [[Wispfire Lantern]]
* [[Voltvessels]]
* Other sources of heat (i.e. a [[Memoria]] blown up by another Memoria's electrified explosive). 

[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] may carry up to 15 Seared Organs, after which they are no longer obtainable.
